items.focus: Chop wood, relight camp, raise temperature; add palisade, transport, mining and stronger buildings.
Collect/load timber, feed furnace, build bridge, open new resource routes.
Manual timber -> fishing -> food processing -> workers/machines; raw resource stays visually traceable into output.
Net fishing -> fish processing -> workers -> expanded food supply.
One-tap clearing -> houses -> resource gathering -> forge -> camp recovery.
Rescue survivors -> restore furnace -> coal upgrades -> housing -> functioning town.
Immediate attack -> cooking/building -> polar bear/enemy waves -> defend upgraded camp.
Catapults -> enemy waves -> stronger turrets/production/soldiers -> boss/polar-bear escalation.
